title: Report a bare [[name]] link that matches no page: lint and graph count it as neither resolved nor dangling
notes: Found mounting Vibra-Lab/brain-vibra on 2026-11-24. Its pages link private pages of the author's instance by name ([[access-map]], [[companies]]); on the office instance, where those pages do not exist, 'brain lint' prints 0 issues and 'brain graph' dangling 0. The same links written with a folder were reported as dangling.
done_when: lint lists an unresolved bare link, in a way an instance mounting a shared brain can tell from a link broken inside its own pages.
